positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I work in Digital Supply Chain Engineering, focusing on music, books and podcasts. My current role focuses on big data processing for a variety of our services.

My previous role at Apple from 2019-2022 focused on ingesting, validating and processing metadata and assets from content providers to then be vended to our customers in our various services.

volunteerExperiences.description: I designed, created and delivered a web development curriculum suitable for high school students. Additionally, I taught a two-hour lab once a week and provided feedback to parents and students.
I coordinated with two other facilitators to teach a two-hour lab to middle school girls once a week using the GWC python curriculum. Additionally I provided feedback to parents and students.
